Anya Patel: Quick reminder — v2.7.0 release cutoff is EOD PT tomorrow. If you're planning a version bump or changelog entry, please get PRs in and mark them with the `release/v2.7` label.

Sundeep Rao: Thanks — I'm going to land the model-quant PR today. Will need a quick CI green check afterward.

Josh M: Ping @Sundeep — FYI there's a flaky test in `integration/redis_cache_test` that failed on main twice this morning. Might block the green sweep.

CI Bot: Build #4821 failed on job `integration-tests`
```
FAIL: integration/redis_cache_test.go:87: TestCacheExpiry
--- FAIL: TestCacheExpiry (0.14s)
cache_test.go:91: expected key to expire after 100ms, saw 230ms
```

Dev Infra: I can rerun just the failed matrix for that job. @CI Bot can you trigger a rerun for build 4821?

CI Bot: Rerun queued for build #4821 (matrix: linux-go1.20). Estimated start in ~45s. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Maggie L: I can take the flaky triage. If it flakes again, please don't rebase — save the logs and @maggie will grab them. Common culprit is timing on CI VMs; we may need to add a small test tolerance.

Sundeep Rao: Appreciate it. I added a short sleep in a local repro and it passed. Will open a tiny fix and add a test comment so reviewers know it's non-deterministic.

Anya Patel: Also: tiny changelog nudge — make sure each PR has a one-line changelog under `/changelogs/`. If you can't add one, drop a note in the PR and I'll add it during cut.

Josh M: For branching: if anyone needs to cherry-pick after cutoff, shout here and @release-leads will evaluate case-by-case. Avoid last-minute infra churn pls. :pray:

CI Bot: Build #4821 retriggered — status: running.

Maggie L: Update — the rerun passed the integration matrix. Looks like a flake (timing). I'll file a short flaky test ticket and propose a 50ms tolerance.

Sundeep Rao: Landing the PR now, will tag with `release/v2.7` and add changelog entry.

Anya Patel: Thanks all. Last green sweep tomorrow 10:00am PT — we'll do a final smoke pass then. If anything blocks, post here and we'll escalate. :shipit:
